sources.title: Granite-4.0-H-Micro official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact IBM instruct checkpoint, Apache 2.0 license and October 2, 2025 release. The H Micro Dense column explicitly labels both total and active parameters 3B; lists four attention and 36 Mamba2 layers. Provides text generation and tool-calling examples.

sources.title: IBM Granite 4.0 launch announcement, October 2, 2025
sources.evidence: Announces H-Micro as a dense hybrid, distinct from conventional Micro and MoE Tiny/Small. Specifies Mamba2/attention, dense feedforward layers and NoPE; validates 128K context despite training samples up to 512K. Separates the released Instruct variants from future explicit-reasoning variants.

sources.title: Pinned H-Micro configuration
sources.evidence: 40 layers: attention at zero-based indices 5, 15, 25 and 35, otherwise Mamba; hidden size 2048; vocabulary 100352; 32 attention/8 KV heads; MLP width 8192; no positional encoding; zero local or selected experts; tied word embeddings; BF16; maximum positions 131072. No quantization configuration.

sources.title: Pinned original checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps 466 tensors to two shards; total_size is 6,382,792,192 bytes. The total_parameters field is a zero placeholder, not a usable count. No separate lm_head, quantization-scale, router or rotary-frequency entries appear.

sources.title: First BF16 shard tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 range requests read the eight-byte header length and 39,912-byte JSON header only. Shapes, dtypes and offsets were inventoried without tensor payloads; together with the second shard, all 466 tensors exactly match the index and sum to 3,191,396,096 BF16 elements.

sources.title: Second BF16 shard tensor header
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 range requests read the eight-byte header length and 11,928-byte JSON header only. The combined learned-tensor total is 3,191,396,096, including the 205,520,896-element shared embedding once; headers contain no packed weights, quantization scales or non-parameter buffers.

sources.title: Original model repository metadata
sources.evidence: Repository revision d5f01a3ea75f088947be3aae039f4ad52837dfde independently reports safetensors total 3,191,396,096, entirely BF16. Metadata and checkpoint index corroborate the bounded header count.

sources.title: Granite hybrid implementation matching the checkpoint config version
sources.evidence: Mamba A_log, D and dt_bias are nn.Parameters, as are linear, convolution and norm weights. NoPE does not instantiate rotary buffers. Zero experts bypasses routed MoE while the dense shared_mlp runs in each block. lm_head.weight is tied; embedding lookup, selective Mamba activations, caches and logits_to_keep explain why a nominal active figure is not an exact per-token weight-access count.

sources.title: Pinned H-Micro conversation template
sources.evidence: Serializes text content, function definitions, tool calls and tool responses. No image/audio processing or thinking-mode switch is supplied; generation examples and model structure are text-only.

sources.title: Granite 4.0 language-model repository
sources.evidence: Distinguishes dense, dense-hybrid and MoE-hybrid releases and lists H-Micro separately from Micro. Current README still has a commented future technical-report reference; the exact card citation contains a placeholder arXiv identifier, which is not treated as a published report.

sources.title: Granite 4.1 LLMs: How They Are Built, April 29, 2026
sources.evidence: Later first-party technical walkthrough describes 4.1 as dense Transformers with RoPE and compares 4.1-8B with 4.0-H-Small. These later-generation specifications are not transferred to H-Micro; the exact 4.0 card supplies its own total/active comparison table.

name.note: Exact instruct variant; distinct from Micro, H-Micro-Base, H-Tiny and Granite 4.1.

developer.note: The model card credits the Granite Team at IBM.

release_date.note: Explicit original public release date, corroborated by the dated launch announcement.

open_weights.note: Original BF16 checkpoint shards are publicly readable without authentication.

license.note: IBM explicitly releases these weights under Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned-parameter count: 3,191,396,096. Counts tied embeddings once; includes learned Mamba A_log/D/dt_bias, convolutions, dense MLPs, attention and norms. All tensors are BF16; no quantization scales or persistent buffers inflate the sum. IBM markets this as nominal 3B.

active_parameters_b.note: IBM explicitly labels H Micro Dense as 3B active: retain this nominal source-defined count. It is not inferred from density or replaced by the precise total. There is no expert routing; input embedding lookup touches selected rows, the tied vocabulary projection is evaluated only for requested logit positions, and Mamba input-dependent state coefficients are activations rather than additional or routed learned weights. No exact phase-specific active count is asserted.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only hybrid: 36 Mamba2 and four GQA attention layers, each with a dense SwiGLU MLP; RMSNorm, NoPE and tied embeddings. The generic GraniteMoeHybrid class name does not make this checkpoint MoE: both expert counts are zero.

context_window.note: Exact configured limit, consistent with IBM validation at 128K. Longer training sequences and theoretical unbounded SSM context do not establish a larger supported context.

modalities.note: Tokenizer-based causal language model with text-only content handling and vocabulary output; no vision or audio components.

reasoning.note: Instruct release without a dedicated thinking mode. IBM explicitly distinguished it from then-planned reasoning variants; false does not mean incapable of ordinary reasoning or chain-of-thought prompting.

tool_call.note: Official function-calling example and tool-definition/call/response serialization establish support.

description.value: IBM instruction-tuned text model combining Mamba2 and attention layers with dense feedforward blocks, supporting multilingual chat, coding, retrieval-augmented generation and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces vague compact/enterprise wording with the documented architecture and uses.

patch.description: IBM instruction-tuned text model combining Mamba2 and attention layers with dense feedforward blocks, supporting multilingual chat, coding, retrieval-augmented generation and tool calling.
patch.notes: Total is the exact 3,191,396,096 learned-parameter count from the original BF16 checkpoint headers, including tied embeddings once. IBM labels this model 3B total and 3B active; active_parameters_b preserves that nominal published figure, not an exact per-token or phase-specific count. Dense MLPs have no routed experts. Configured and validated context is 131,072 tokens; larger training samples do not change that supported limit.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Add Apache-2.0, dense hybrid SSM/Transformer architecture, exact 3.191396096B total and explicitly published nominal 3B active. Confirm October 2, 2025 release, 131072-token context, text modalities, tool calling and absence of a dedicated reasoning mode. Header-only audit accounts for all learned tensors and tied aliases; no complete weight shards downloaded. Current 4.0 documentation and later 4.1 technical comparisons were checked without substituting sibling specifications.
